text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo...! Where could I have left 
it...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I went through all the trouble of making 
so many flyers for today's street live, 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that someone took all of 
them...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No fair! Only one flyer per person! Falco 
is an Umadol for everyone, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon ran all over the place 
searching for the paper bag with the 
flyers, completely wearing herself out.
